user.title: Choose the main device
user.description: Choose the device that already has the MAC address, or select manual entry. Registered MAC addresses appear next to each device.

devices.title: Choose devices to link
devices.description: Select all devices to link to {main_name}. You can select multiple devices.

confirm.title: Confirm the shared MAC address
confirm.description: Selected devices: {linked_device_names}. Confirm the MAC address for {main_name}; it will be added to all selected devices.

data.selected_mac_address: MAC address on the main device

discovery_mac.title: Link {device_a} with {device_b}?
discovery_mac.description: These devices share a MAC address, so this is a strong match even when they are in different areas. {device_a} ({integration_a}) is in {area_a}. {device_b} ({integration_b}) is in {area_b}.

discovery_identifier.title: Link {device_a} with {device_b}?
discovery_identifier.description: These devices share a hardware identifier, such as a Zigbee address, Bluetooth MAC, or serial number. {device_a} ({integration_a}) is in {area_a}. {device_b} ({integration_b}) is in {area_b}.

discovery_name.title: Link {device_a} with {device_b}?
discovery_name.description: These devices are in the same area and their names are similar ({score}). {device_a} ({integration_a}) and {device_b} ({integration_b}), area {area_a}.

error.device_not_found: A selected device is no longer available. Choose the devices again.
error.same_config_entry: Choose devices from different integrations. Devices from the same integration cannot share this MAC address.
error.no_linked_devices: Select at least one device to link.
error.invalid_mac: Select a discovered MAC address or enter a valid MAC address, such as AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.
error.connection_conflict: The MAC address is already assigned to {conflicting_devices}. Select a different MAC address or remove the conflicting device.

abort.already_configured: This device group and MAC address are already configured.
abort.no_devices: Add devices in another integration before configuring Device Linker.
abort.ignored: This link suggestion was ignored and will not be offered again.

configure.title: Edit linked devices
configure.description: The main device stays the same. Currently selected devices: {linked_device_names}. Update the MAC address or change the selection. Remove a device to unlink it; clear the selection to unlink all devices. Suggestion settings at the bottom apply to every Device Linker entry.

data.selected_mac_address: MAC address on the main device
data.match_names: Suggest similar names in the same area

error.same_config_entry: Choose devices from different integrations. Devices from the same integration cannot share this MAC address.

rescan_suggestions.name: Rescan suggestions
rescan_suggestions.description: Look again for devices that share a MAC address or hardware identifier, and for devices in the same area with similar names.
